structured_output.summary: Changed src/input/keyboard.ts onDown. A Space keydown whose target is inside a button, link or form field (new INTERACTIVE selector) is now left alone when Space isn't already held: no preventDefault and no action latch. The browser's own Space activation of the focused RACE, RESUME or NEXT RACE button works again. onUp is unchanged. It only prevents a keyup whose keydown was handled, so this ignored keydown leaves its keyup alone too. A Space held from the race into a newly shown overlay is still latched, so its keyup is still prevented and can't click NEXT RACE by accident. Space anywhere else (body/window, e.g. during a race) still calls preventDefault and fires the power-up as before, so the AC7 tests, replays and sim are unaffected. New test tests/input/space-on-button.test.ts covers two cases: (1) the verifier's game-level repro, Space keydown and keyup on the focused start-screen RACE button are not defaultPrevented; (2) createKeyboard(window) doesn't report actionPressed for Space on a button but still does, with preventDefault, for Space on body. Both failed before the fix and pass after it. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes: 111 files, 745 tests.
